exercises.title: Irregular Verbs — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma sul recupero contestuale delle forme irregolari al Past Simple e del past participle.
exercises.instructions: Non recitare liste: usa la struttura della frase per capire quale forma serve.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Individua prima se serve base form, Past Simple o past participle.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: Yesterday Luca ___ his keys on the kitchen table.
questions.instructions: Choose the correct form of leave.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve the irregular Past Simple form from a finished past context.

feedback.explanation: Leave → left in the Past Simple.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.instructions: Choose the correct form of write.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve the irregular past participle after has.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.instructions: Choose the form required by each structure.
questions.learning_objective: Distinguish Past Simple and past participle forms of the same irregular verb.

content.text_template: I [[blank_1]] that film last year, but my sister has never [[blank_2]] it.

feedback.explanation: Past Simple: saw. After has: seen.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.instructions: Write the correct Past Simple forms.
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve several high-frequency irregular Past Simple forms in connected context.

content.text_template: On Saturday we [[blank_1]] (get) up early, [[blank_2]] (take) the train to Venice, [[blank_3]] (eat) lunch near the station and [[blank_4]] (come) home late.

questions.title: Item 5
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve several high-frequency irregular past participles after have/has.

content.text_template: We have [[blank_1]] (do) the exercise, Sara has [[blank_2]] (take) the photos and I have [[blank_3]] (write) the message.

feedback.explanation: Do → done; take → taken; write → written.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.prompt: Correct: I have went to that restaurant twice.
questions.instructions: Rewrite the sentence with the correct verb form.
questions.learning_objective: Correct confusion between an irregular Past Simple form and its participle.

accepted_answers: I have gone to that restaurant twice.
I've gone to that restaurant twice.

feedback.explanation: After have, go → gone, not went.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.prompt: Select all sentences with the correct irregular form.
questions.instructions: There may be more than one correct answer.
questions.learning_objective: Evaluate Past Simple and participle forms across several irregular verbs.

options.text: I have chose the blue one.
He teached me how to use it.
We found the address last night.

feedback.explanation: Check whether the context needs Past Simple or a participle and then retrieve the irregular form.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.learning_objective: Retrieve an irregular form naturally inside a short conversation.

turns.speaker: Mia
turns.text: Did you bring the history book?

options.text: I have lefted it at home.

feedback.explanation: Leave → left in this completed past reply.

questions.title: Item 9
questions.prompt: Ieri ho preso il treno sbagliato, ma ho trovato una persona che mi ha detto dove scendere.
questions.learning_objective: Produce several high-frequency irregular Past Simple forms in connected language.

accepted_answers: Yesterday I took the wrong train, but I found someone who told me where to get off.
Yesterday I took the wrong train, but I found a person who told me where to get off.

feedback.explanation: Take → took; find → found; tell → told.

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Ho già scritto la relazione, ma ieri ho scritto solo l'introduzione. Marco ha fatto le foto; io le ho viste stamattina.
questions.instructions: Translate the full context into English.
questions.learning_objective: Switch accurately between irregular Past Simple and participle forms in connected production.

accepted_answers: I have already written the report, but yesterday I only wrote the introduction. Marco has taken the photos; I saw them this morning.
I've already written the report, but yesterday I only wrote the introduction. Marco has taken the photos; I saw them this morning.

feedback.explanation: Written/taken after have/has; wrote/saw for completed past events.
